NP Presspad 1.3.12 — Maintenance

Maintenance release — dependency updates only, no user-facing changes. **No companion plugin update needed.**

This release refreshes the libraries NP Presspad is built on. Everything here is under the hood; the app looks and works exactly as before.

## Dependency updates

- **Rich text editor (Tiptap)** 3.32.0 → 3.32.2 — the editor at the heart of writing and formatting your posts, with the latest upstream fixes.
- **Electron** 44.9.3 → 44.10.0 — the application framework (Chromium + Node.js runtime), with the latest fixes from the Electron 44 line.
- **Auto-updater (electron-updater)** 6.8.11 → 6.8.12 — the component that delivers these updates to you; this bump hardens how updates are downloaded over redirects and resumed from a partial download.
- **Lucide icons** 1.61.0 → 1.66.0 — the icon set used across the interface.
- **Markdown parser (marked)** 18.1.1 → 18.1.2 — used when converting content to and from Markdown.
